text:
You need a multi-page React app for a school project with JWT login/signup, a SQL/Node backend, Axios, and GET/POST/PUT API requests.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I built the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token by token for Quillstack, with the first token on screen in about 600 ms. I also built a dispatcher map for Ferrylane Freight that showed every truck’s position and ETA, with GPS pings reaching the screen in under 2 seconds.

For your project, I can set up the auth flow, API page, and backend structure cleanly so it’s easy to demo and explain. Would you like the app organized with separate pages for sign up/login and the API view, or do you want any additional screens?
